author: Discovery
description:
Moonshiners goes back in time by recreating historic liquors using old school methods and recipes that have been passed down for generations, showing how these drinks were originally made. It explores these traditions by bringing back Popcorn Sutton’s Appalachian moonshine, Maggie Valley’s classic spirits, and the bold whiskey styles from the Gold Rush, Pancho Villa’s era, and Abe Lincoln’s frontier days.
#Moonshiners Tuesdays at 8P on #Discovery

Stream Full Episodes of Moonshiners:
https://www.discoveryplus.com/show/moonshiners

About Moonshiners:
Every spring, a fearless group of men and women venture deep into the woods of Appalachia, defying the law, rivals and nature itself to keep the centuries-old tradition of craft whiskey alive.
